title: MCP Servers for AI Agents: Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor | APIStack
excerpt: Give your AI agent reliable tools through Model Context Protocol servers: date math, validation, finance calculators, DNS lookups and more.
content_html:
Give AI agents like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor exact, deterministic tools through the Model Context Protocol

No sign-up needed · 50 free calls a day

Facts and checks for your agent

16 focused tools for questions agents should not answer from memory: the current time, holidays and working days, exchange rates, VAT and IBAN checks, company lookups, link safety, sanctions screening and more. Add the URL and it works right away; add a free API key when you need more than 50 calls a day.

https://apistack.online/api/mcp/facts

  • get_current_time · Current time in a time zone
  • find_meeting_time · Shared working hours across time zones
  • list_public_holidays · Public holidays
  • check_working_day · Is a date a working day?
  • add_working_days · Add working days
  • date_difference · Difference between two dates
  • convert_currency · Convert currency
  • validate_vat_number · Check an EU VAT number
  • validate_iban · Validate an IBAN
  • validate_email · Validate an email address
  • validate_phone · Validate a phone number
  • lookup_company · Look up a company
  • check_url_safety · Check if a link looks risky
  • geocode_city · Find a city
  • screen_sanctions · Screen a name against sanctions lists
  • economic_snapshot · Economic indicators for a country

Full catalog · API key

Every APIStack API through one endpoint

Add one MCP server and your agent can search the whole catalog, read an API's details and run it: three tools (search_apis, get_api_details, call_api) instead of dozens, so it stays light on context.

  • • Uses your APIStack key, plan access and quota, just like the REST API
  • • Want specific tools instead? Add ?categories=finance,utilities or ?apis=email-address-validator to the URL
  • • Streamable HTTP transport; works with Claude, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP clients

https://apistack.online/api/mcp/connect

Replace YOUR_API_KEY with the key from your dashboard (free account works).

Watch the 90-second setup · 1:34

Give your AI agent 100+ tools with one MCP URL

Connect APIStack to Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or your own agent, with a real agent run.

Dedicated servers

Single-purpose servers with hand-written tools (Pro and Enterprise).

Sign In Required

Dedicated servers require a PRO or Enterprise subscription (the unified endpoint above works on every plan).Sign in to access.

AI-ready Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that integrate with your AI tools. Bridge your applications and AI assistants with contextual, data-aware conversations.

Our MCP servers are currently in development. We're working hard to bring you powerful, context-aware integrations that will revolutionize how you interact with AI.

Stay tuned for updates on our progress!
